name: Pistol Guide
description: A dependable early firearm for learning creature movement, conserving shots and setting up simple trick kills.
imageAlt: Game-derived Pistol model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Best use
paragraphs: Use the pistol when control matters more than burst damage. It is well suited to ordinary catches and learning how targets move around the boat.
bullets: Fire deliberately instead of emptying a magazine.
Create a clear background for trick shots.
Move to a heavier option for large bosses if fights drag on.

sections.heading: Upgrade logic
paragraphs: Use one eligible firearm with a non-default optic, at least one damage upgrade, a muzzle attachment, laser sight and extended magazine. All five conditions must be active for Fully equipped.

name: Shotgun Guide
description: A forgiving close-range choice when a newly landed creature is already crowding the boat.
imageAlt: Game-derived Shotgun model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Best use
paragraphs: The shotgun is strongest when the target is close and large enough for the spread to connect. Reposition before firing if an NPC, explosive object or teammate is in the line.
bullets: Wait for a clean close-range window.
Carry a ranged alternative for birds and distant bosses.

name: Sniper Rifle Guide
description: A long-range option for deliberate trick shots, flying targets and clean sightlines.
imageAlt: Game-derived Sniper Rifle model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Best use
paragraphs: Use the sniper rifle when the target path is predictable and the battlefield is open. It rewards preparation more than panic firing.
bullets: Watch one movement cycle before shooting.
Use a faster secondary option when creatures reach the boat.

sections.heading: Multiplier play
paragraphs: Precision weapons pair naturally with 360, no-scope, headshot and distance conditions. Watch one movement cycle first so a missed setup does not slow a money route.

name: Assault Rifle Guide
description: A flexible late-route weapon for maintaining pressure on large creatures and boss targets.
imageAlt: Game-derived Assault Rifle model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Best use
paragraphs: Sustained fire helps when a large target stays exposed, but only if you can control the weapon and afford the ammunition. Short bursts preserve accuracy.
bullets: Favor mobility over standing still to finish a magazine.

name: Dynamite Guide
description: A fast bulk-kill tool and physics launcher with two dedicated achievement uses.
imageAlt: Game-derived Dynamite model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Best use
paragraphs: Dynamite costs $25 in the early shop route and is useful for clustered creatures. It is also required for Everyone's dream and the boat-launching I'm the bird now challenge.
bullets: Practice the fuse timing before achievement attempts.

name: Brass Knuckles Guide
description: An early melee upgrade for finishing ordinary creatures without spending ammunition.
imageAlt: Game-derived Brass Knuckles model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Best use
paragraphs: Use Brass Knuckles for low-health catches when ammunition costs more than the time saved. Do not confuse ordinary melee cleanup with the Handyman challenge, which requires fists for the final boss.

name: Knife Guide
description: A stronger early melee finisher that preserves ammunition on small and medium catches.
imageAlt: Game-derived Knife model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Best use
paragraphs: Use the Knife when a creature is already controlled on land or in the boat. It is an economy tool, not a safe answer to large charge bosses.

name: SMG / Uzi Guide
description: A flexible mid-game weapon for Blue Shark, Albatross and other moving targets.
imageAlt: Game-derived SMG model from How to Fish

sections.heading: Best use
paragraphs: The weapon is labeled SMG in some inventories and called Uzi by many guides. Its fast follow-up shots make it practical for Blue Shark and the flying Albatross.
bullets: Buy magazine upgrades only for a weapon you plan to keep.
Carry enough ammunition before using a single-use boss lure.
